oral_examination.oral_examination: 24 Grade III loosening, percussion (-), no abnormality in the buccal mucosa, nothing special. Red and swollen gums, dental calculus ( ), nothing else. CBCT shows: low-density image of the root tip.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local iodophor disinfection, local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine, separation of the gums after the anesthesia takes effect, extraction of the loose teeth, scraping of the granulation tissue in the extraction socket, placement of iodoform gauze strips in the extraction socket, suturing and compression to stop bleeding .
